correctness.rationale: For all \(n\ge4\), counting-measure Schur orthogonality gives a conjugation orbit frame on \(\operatorname{End}(V)\). Four inequivalent irreducible sectors have dimensions 1,n-1,\(n(n-3)/2\),\((n-1)(n-2)/2\). Their squared energies are respectively (f-1)^2/(n-1), f(n-f)/(n-2), the Hilbert-Schmidt residual, and (n-f-2t)/2; all follow from character trace, centered fixed-point indicators, and permutation skew matrices. Schur averaging gives exact eigenvalues (n-1)|C|/n! times \(R_j/D_j\). The residual factorization and n=4 direct cases yield the sharp injectivity criterion. Exact integer class-Gram annihilators plus spectral trace moments for all 38 classes through n=7 corroborate but do not prove the general statement. No normalization or boundary assumption was left unchecked.

value.rationale: Conjugacy classes are natural invariant sampling geometries. The theorem uniformly determines every standard-block concentration singular value for all n and all cycle types, compresses the density-normalized answer to two cycle statistics, and precisely characterizes injectivity. This resolves genuine structural interpolation and rank questions for n-cycles, involution classes and mixed classes beyond individual previous transposition/three-cycle cases; it is not merely a table recomputation or arbitrary special parameter choice. Historical equivalent formulations remain a qualified risk.
